copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道

copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 它把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进 NanoClaw 项目、注册成通道并安装指定版本的依赖包，然后跑构建和一条注册测试确认接好；桥接服务在 3000 端口处理 /webhook/whatsapp-cloud。Meta 后台的凭据步骤需你人工完成。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加上官方 Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API 通道时使用；装完可运行 /manage-channels 把该通道接到某个 agent group。

say.text: 帮我用官方 Meta API 接上 WhatsApp Cloud 通道

say.text: 跑一下 whatsapp-cloud 的注册测试，确认通道注册好了
say.note: 变红说明导入行或依赖漂移了

say.text: 我的 WhatsApp 收不到消息，帮我查 webhook
say.note: 会先看 3000 端口和验证令牌

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter in, registers the channel, installs the pinned adapter package, then builds and runs a registration test. The bridge serves /webhook/whatsapp-cloud on port 3000.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw; after install, run /manage-channels to wire the channel to an agent group.

say_en.text: Connect the WhatsApp Cloud channel via the official Meta API
say_en.note: Copies, registers, installs deps, then builds
Red means the barrel import or dependency drifted

say_en.text: I get no WhatsApp messages, check the webhook
say_en.note: Checks port 3000 and the verify token
